scope: Broaden DWG/DXF implementation research with current Autodesk release-family compatibility, newly surfaced peer repository ancestry, and route/API normalization requirements. Refine the implementation plan without asserting local defects or promoting support claims.

method.kind: Primary vendor support articles and primary project repository/API/changelog pages
method.sourcePinning: The reviewed vendor/project pages are current but mutable. This receipt records a documentation snapshot only; any implementation differential must pin exact source commit/package, build or artifact, platform, route, input provenance, and options.
method.evidenceRule: A product release name, shared AC code, repository fork, feature matrix, or API-level round trip is not per-feature semantic evidence. Keep producer identity, file version, parser lineage, direction, units, object graph, diagnostics, and consumer result distinct.

evidence.topic: AC1032 spans multiple AutoCAD product releases
evidence.observed: Autodesk's current compatibility page lists AutoCAD 2018 through 2027 as using the AutoCAD 2018 native DWG format; the version-code page identifies AC1032 with AutoCAD 2018 through 2024. Autodesk's page separately notes that AutoCAD Mechanical uses its own DWG format. The shared AC1032 marker does not identify the exact producer release or prove that a tested AC1032 file exercises all features of later products.
doesNotEstablish: that every AutoCAD 2018-2027 product emits identical object content or semantics
that AC1032 samples cover every feature introduced in later product releases
Mechanical DWG compatibility through the ordinary AC1032 reader path
a need for a new AC version code or reader solely because the product year changed
evidence.planUse: Record exact producer/build and save-as version alongside AC code for external samples. Scope results to observed feature profiles. Keep Mechanical files explicitly outside scope unless separately qualified.

evidence.observed: The compscientific/cadcodec GitHub page declares a fork relationship to HakanSeven12/opencadcodec and its README identifies the Rust crate as acadrust. Earlier source review in this plan records opencadcodec as an ACadRust descendant. This adds an alias/branch to the known family, not an independent decoder vote.
doesNotEstablish: that current descendant source is byte-for-byte identical to its parent
that advertised version/entity support has been executed or independently verified
semantic DWG/DXF, AcDs, or ACIS support
evidence.planUse: Extend the peer lineage ledger and require exact ancestry/path review before selecting a comparator. Count the descendants as one parser family absent evidence of a distinct decoder implementation.

evidence.topic: ezdwg narrow native routes and API unit boundary
evidence.observed: The project documents native AC1021/AC1024/AC1027/AC1032 decoding for selected 2D entities with paired-DXF regression comparisons; the raw API expresses ARC angles in radians while the high-level API expresses them in degrees. The documented native DWG writer targets a narrower AC1015 subset, and DWG-to-DXF conversion uses ezdxf as a backend.
doesNotEstablish: execution of the current branch or a specific released package in this research pass
complete read/write parity for any listed version
equivalence between raw and normalized high-level values without conversion rules
evidence.planUse: Keep ezdwg an optional composed-gate differential for overlapping 2D records. Prefer raw values or normalize units explicitly, and record native read, high-level normalization, converter-backed output, and native writer as separate routes.

versionEvidenceFields: producer application/product build and platform when known
saved AC code and save-as/export version
entity/object feature profile and source handles/owners
peerDifferentialFields: repository and package identity plus exact revision/artifact digest
parser-source ancestry and independent decoder path
raw versus normalized API layer and units
diagnostics, skipped/refused/lost disposition, and graph outcome
implementationReadiness.validationCadence: No per-slice validation expansion. Keep local strict touched-target build, focused fast test, relevant LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3 compatibility compile, and diff check. Use optional exact-pinned peer checks only at the existing composed checkpoint.
